thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: p99 latency for /v1/generate exceeded 7s in last 5m. Autopager fired. PagerDuty: PD-3892. https://grafana.internal/d/abcd1234/requests

pagerduty: Pager PD-3892 triggered -> escalated to alice_oncall (primary).

alice_oncall: ack. I'm on it. pinging bob_sre and dave_infra.

bob_sre: looking at traces now. p50 fine, p95 ~1.2s, p99 jumped to 8-12s. Heatmap shows a spike from eu-west region.

dave_infra: checking autoscaler + GPU pool. No recent deploys?

carla_pm: any customer-facing reports? emma_custops can you check?

emma_custops: reaching out to top 3 customers using dedicated -> holding.

alice_oncall: runbook step1: check KV cache hitrate and batcher backlog. Bob, run these commands?

bob_sre: running:
`curl -s "https://grafana.internal/api/datasources/proxy/1/api/datasources/proxy/1/query?query=kv_cache_hit_ratio" | jq .`
cache hitratio down to 32% on eu-west. Batcher latency queue length spiked to 120.

bob_sre: also saw increase in large context requests (/generate with seq_len>4096). Possibly model path selection falling back to slower variant.

dave_infra: autoscaler shows nodes saturated, preemptions in cloud logs. Kicking an emergency scale up now.

alice_oncall: temp mitigation: enable fallback-rule to route eu-west low-priority traffic to dedicated-fallback pool. @dave_infra can you flip the route?

dave_infra: done. route change in routing-config:
`/v1/generate -> eu-west: dedicated-fallback (weight: 30%)` pushed.

bob_sre: cache warm command:
`./tools/kv_preload --region eu-west --prefix common_prompts --concurrency 8`
started preload.

alice_oncall: monitoring p99.

(2m later)

bob_sre: p99 down to ~4.6s, cache hitratio climbing to 58%.

pagerduty: note: PD-3892 acknowledged by alice_oncall at 1792223340.

carla_pm: update: no customer tickets yet; emma still waiting on responses.

emma_custops: customer A replied "we see slower responses" — asked if alpha fallback might help; told them we're doing routing changes.

alice_oncall: raising severity to S2 due to potential degrade. Triage: cause = KV-cache coldness / autoscaler lag + large sequence requests. Next -> consider temporary rate-limit of huge contexts.

bob_sre: applying a soft token-limit check in the edge:
`if seq_len > 4096 -> reject with 413 + guidance`
pushing now.

dave_infra: cluster scaled +2 nodes; preemptions stopped.

bob_sre: after soft limit, p99 now 2.1s for routed traffic. Total error rate unchanged.

alice_oncall: good. emma, prep a short customer note: "We're mitigating a latency issue affecting a subset of requests in EU—temporary routing + limits applied. We'll follow up in 60m."

emma_custops: drafting and will post to status page in 5m.

alice_oncall: moving to handoff in 30m if stable. Who takes next shift?

bob_sre: I can take rotation follow-up. Will make a postmortem entry and collect logs.

dave_infra: leaving scaling watch on until +1h.

carla_pm: thanks all — keep me posted if we need rollback or model swap.

(30m later)

bob_sre: p99 stable ~1.8s, cache hitratio 78%, no new PD alerts.

alice_oncall: closing PD incident? recommend keep incident open for 2h for monitoring.

pagerduty: PD-3892 resolved by alice_oncall at 1792223605.

incident-bot: Incident PD-3892 marked resolved. :white_check_mark: Summary: EU-west p99 spike caused by KV cache coldness and large-context requests; mitigations: emergency scale up, routing to dedicated-fallback, KV preload, soft seq_len limit. Owner: bob_sre for post-incident followup.
